purpose: Teach: 本校/（財）/先ごろ/片っ端/遅ればせながら/討ち/新報/追いつめ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本校、つまり本校の医学生実習を医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Ren — we're supporting the medical students' clinical rotations here as a coordinated medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Measured pace. Addresses Ren directly with his name, then shifts into briefing mode. Steady gaze, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、（財）法人、つまり（財）系の医療機関と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren — we're coordinating with the foundation-affiliated medical facilities as part of our healthcare team.
lines.style: Same professional register. Slight emphasis on 'coordinating' — showing how the pieces fit together. Calm authority, not condescending.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、先ごろ発表の臨床ガイドラインを医療チームで読み込みます
lines.en: Ren — our healthcare team is going to carefully review the clinical guidelines that were just released.
lines.style: Tempo stays steady. Light emphasis on 'carefully' — this matters. Voice carries weight but not urgency. No rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、片っ端から症例文献を医療チームで集めます
lines.en: Ren — we're systematically gathering case studies and literature as a coordinated medical team.
lines.style: Methodical delivery. 'Systematically' lands with purpose. Voice shows competence and thoroughness without pressure. Clinical but warm.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、遅ればせながら気付いた症例を医療チームで再評価します
lines.en: Ren — we've identified some cases we missed at first, and we'll be re-evaluating them together with the team.
lines.style: Slight dip in confidence here — not shame, but honesty. 'Missed' is soft but clear. Then recovers into collaborative tone. Measured but genuine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染源を討ち取る、つまり撲滅する取り組みを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren — we're working as a team to eliminate the source of infection — that's our priority.
lines.style: Firmer tone. 'Eliminate' carries weight and determination. Voice shows this isn't academic — there's urgency beneath the calm. Still controlled.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新報、つまり新報の医療記事を医療チームで参照します
lines.en: Ren — our medical team will be reviewing the health reports in the medical press and staying current.
lines.style: Returns to steady professional briefing mode. Tempo measured. Shows diligence without drama. Voice is reliable, almost routine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、病気を追いつめ、つまり追い詰める診断を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren — we're going to narrow down the diagnosis and corner this illness systematically as a team.
lines.style: Final statement carries quiet intensity. 'Narrow down' and 'corner' build momentum slightly. Voice feels purposeful, clinical, but deeply committed. Closes steady.
